safetyControls: Read-only data access; no sending, posting, approvals, payments, dispatch commits or database administration.
Historical application dates remain historical. The agent must disclose empty or failed results.
Currency, organization, join grain and evidence limitations remain visible. Integration users are for demos, not per-person application authorization.
setup: Import the release .paf with the repository archive passphrase. Imported flows are unpublished until reviewed.
Select an available tool-capable LLM on every Agent node. The demo used xai.grok-4.3; model connections are not bundled.
Create or reuse JD Edwards Manufacturing Read Only and rebind the nodes listed in assets/source-bindings.json.
Upload the supplied paf-demo-dispatch-plan.csv using the corresponding Builder component and select the uploaded filename.

Disable Agent Memory and sharing between chat threads for this flow. This instance enables them by default; the official export does not include those switches. Run the documented primary prompt, inspect the evidence and dates, then publish for the demo audience.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: Use the sample dispatch plan to check material readiness for one work order. Explain which parts need a planner check.

expectedOutcomes: A fictional dispatch plan paired with real work-order components and indicative stock.
The first prompt returns source-backed findings with source dates and units.
The follow-up stays within the documented data and action boundaries.

validation.environment: build.oracleagentfactory.com; application demo databases or the supplied fictional handbook
notes: One primary business prompt completed against this exact graph on build.oracleagentfactory.com. Response wording depends on the selected model.
Fixed queries were checked separately where present. Database/application sample data was not copied into this repository.
This is a demo validation, not certification of business accuracy, policy compliance or production readiness. Review returned evidence during presentations.
Fixed-query check returned 2 rows on the validation date; live counts can change.
Repeated visible JDE requirement rows are surfaced through REQUIREMENT_SOURCE_ROWS; readiness stays unconfirmed until the planner resolves them.
